column1: # MI2 (korean.trs) supplements, bake-supplements.py: what the text and M2KO.MAP draw that a base face lacks, in the
# base's cell and baseline. Fields: supplement, base face, TTF, size, [mkfont.py flags]; the TTF and size are the
# base's own (m2u.tsv, m2l.tsv) wherever the base is a TrueType bake. The Google NanumGothic-Bold of the U bases has
# no a-circumflex or e-acute (nor Nanum Myeongjo): "A|B" takes those from B, the NHN NanumGothic Bold, at the same size.
# L (1 bpp). M2L1 is neodgm (it has Latin-1); M2L2 is the same hinted Nanum Gothic Bold as its base. M2L0 and
# M2L4 are Taebaek's jamo faces, whose 12x24 ASCII halves draw 0x80-0xFF as Hangul DOS pictographs, no Latin-1:
# the letters come from the hinted Nanum Gothic Bold (M2L0, the gothic verbs) and Gowun Batang Bold (M2L4, the
# serif cards, as in the U preset) at the size whose capital height matches the Taebaek ASCII (17 rows).
